metas.name: The Real Housewives of New York City
metas.description: A fast-paced reality show that follows several incredibly busy and ambitious Manhattan women. Watch as they balance enviable social calendars, challenging careers, and motherhood, with the hustle and bustle of the big city all aro...

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Potomac
metas.description: Follows the lives of 6 women residents of Potomac, Maryland, each in various stages of life and affluence, shaping their community and their lives.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
metas.description: Affluent women attempt to balance their ever-evolving friendships with the demands of family life and growing business ventures while living in Beverly Hills.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
metas.description: A peek inside the unconventional lives of six successful women navigating an exclusive social circle in a city where religion, status and perfection are praised to the highest degree.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Atlanta
metas.description: Housewives live fabulous lives in Georgia's capital, experiencing ups and downs while juggling love with their personal and professional concerns.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of London
metas.description: Showcases the lives and experiences of Juliet Angus, Amanda Cronin, Karen Loderick-Peace, Juliet Mayhew, Panthea Parker, and Nessie Welschinger.

metas.name: Ladies of London
metas.description: Think British high society is all tea parties and politeness? Think again. These social climbers know all too well that living in London luxury has its pitfalls.

metas.name: House of Villains
metas.description: Villains from some of television's most popular reality shows will be put in competition, where each week one will be eliminated until only one winner remains.

metas.name: Selling Sunset
metas.description: The elite real estate brokers at The Oppenheim Group sell the luxe life to affluent buyers in LA. The drama ramps up when a new agent joins the team.

metas.name: Shahs of Sunset
metas.description: Follows a group of affluent young Persian-American friends who juggle their flamboyant, fast-paced L.A. lifestyles with the demands of their families and traditions.

metas.name: Southern Hospitality
metas.description: Follows the lives of a social group of friends living in Charleston, which never sees a dull day in "Leva Land" with the powerful boss, Leva Bonaparte, owner of four restaurants; Republic is the crown jewel of her Kingdom.

metas.name: Selling the OC
metas.description: Jason Oppenheim, owner of the Oppenheim Group, expands the company opening a second office in Newport Beach.

metas.name: Southern Charm
metas.description: Let yourself be enchanted by the social scene, linked to tradition and splendor like no other culture in America, by a group of the city's most charismatic gentlemen and their equally charming Southern belles.

metas.name: The Hills
metas.description: After high school graduation, "Laguna Beach" alumna Lauren sets out to live on her own in Los Angeles and work as an intern at Teen Vogue.

metas.name: Keeping Up with the Kardashians
metas.description: A peek inside the exploits and privileged private lives of the blended Kardashian-Jenner family, including sisters Kim, Kourtney, Khloé, Kendall and Kylie.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Miami
metas.description: "The Real Housewives of Miami" follows six influential women in Miami as they navigate their lavish lifestyles and social connections in the vibrant city known for its non-stop party scene.

metas.name: Love Is Blind
metas.description: Singles who want to be loved for who they are, rather than what they look like, have signed up for a less-conventional approach to modern dating.

metas.name: Winter House
metas.description: Embark on the ultimate winter getaway with some of Bravo's beloved Summer House (2017) and Southern Charm (2013) cast members and their friends during a two-week vacation in Stowe, Vermont.

metas.name: Made in Chelsea
metas.description: A Reality TV show documenting the antics and heartbreaks of a close knit group of twenty-somethings in London's most exclusive borough, Kensington & Chelsea.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Dallas
metas.description: The Real Housewives of Dallas" travels to the southwest with cowboy boots, class and a big dose of sass.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Orange County
metas.description: A look at five families living in a protected Southern California enclave, and the real-life housewives who reside in one of the wealthiest planned communities in the country.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Cheshire
metas.description: Rich, glamorous, powerful, and well-preserved housewives allow cameras into their lives to show viewers their lives--warts and all.

metas.name: Bling Empire
metas.description: Follow L.A.'s wildly-wealthy East Asian and East Asian-American fun-seekers as they go all-out with fabulous parties, glamour, and drama in this reality series.

metas.name: MILF Manor
metas.description: From cities all across the country, eight confident and strong-minded women leave home for the chance to find love at a paradise destination.

metas.name: Jersey Shore
metas.description: A reality-based look at the vapid lives of several New Jersey 20-somethings and their friends and hook-ups.

metas.name: The Only Way Is Essex
metas.description: Part soap opera, part reality show, TOWIE follows the lives, loves and scandals of a group of real-life Essex guys and girls. Cameras capture the happenings at all kinds of glamorous locations as the cast meet up in nail bars, nightclubs and salons. Each episode features action filmed just a few days previously.

metas.name: Vanderpump Rules
metas.description: Best known as one of The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, Lisa Vanderpump opens the salacious kitchen doors of her exclusive Hollywood restaurant and lounge, SUR.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Dubai
metas.description: A group of women navigating their ultra-wealthy lifestyles in the United Arab Emirates.

metas.name: Below Deck
metas.description: A young and single crew lives, loves and works aboard a luxurious yacht, meeting the ever-changing needs of demanding clients while visiting some of the world's most beautiful destinations.

metas.name: The Kardashians
metas.description: Follow the Kardashian family as they celebrate new ventures and navigate through their new normal: motherhood, relationships, and career goals.

metas.name: Too Hot to Handle
metas.description: On the shores of paradise, gorgeous singles meet and mingle. But there's a twist. To win a $100,000 grand prize, they'll have to give up sex.

metas.name: The Traitors
metas.description: Contestants in the game move into a majestic castle and work as a team to complete a series of dramatic and challenging missions to earn money for the prize pot. Some contestants are loyal--but some are traitors.

metas.name: Real Girlfriends in Paris
metas.description: Six twentysomethings embark on an exciting adventure living in the most beautiful city in the world: Paris. While experiencing the spontaneity of a new city. They find the possibilities of true love and forge friendships for life.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of New Jersey
metas.description: Another installment of Bravo's "The Real Housewives" reality show. In this series, they focus on housewives living in New Jersey.

metas.name: Love Island
metas.description: Single hopefuls looking for love complete tasks, couple off and get voted out week by week. Packed full of drama.

metas.name: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On
metas.description: Get hitched or call it quits? Couples put their love to the test--while shacking up with other potential matches--in a provocative reality series.

metas.name: Vanderpump Villa
metas.description: Follows the hand-picked crew of Lisa Vanderpump's opulent French villa as they live and cooperate to satisfy each extravagant want of their affluent visitors.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
metas.description: A tight-knit circle of Rhode Islanders who have deep community roots and families that go back generations.

metas.name: Summer House
metas.description: A group of New Yorkers share a house on the weekends in the luxurious Hamptons, where they go to escape the stress of city life and the only things guaranteed are sun, fun and drama.

metas.name: The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip
metas.description: Housewives visit iconic franchise locations from Orange County to NYC, with fan-favorite stars joining to celebrate past and present moments while looking toward the future.

metas.name: Perfect Match
metas.description: Wealthy Mrs. Li moves her family from Luoyang to Bianjing to find husbands for her five daughters. Despite initial struggles, the family works together to establish a business and search for suitable matches.

metas.name: The Valley
metas.description: Close friends trade bottle service in West Hollywood for baby bottles in the Valley while navigating bustling businesses and rocky relationships.

metas.name: Married to Medicine
metas.description: The ladies of Atlanta's exclusive medical inner circle return with more patients, less patience and a few heart palpitations along the way.

metas.name: Below Deck Sailing Yacht
metas.description: Capt. Glenn Shephard and his crew set sail in a luxury sailing yacht to explore the crystal-clear blue waters of the Ionian Sea. The sailing yacht brings new challenges to these young, attractive and adventurous yachties.

metas.name: Dance Moms
metas.description: The series follows doting mothers and their childrens' early steps on the road to stardom, all under the discerning eye of a notoriously demanding and passionate dance instructor.

metas.name: Below Deck Mediterranean
metas.description: A reality show following the crew and Captain of a luxury charter yacht in the Mediterranean.

metas.name: The Simple Life
metas.description: Paris and Nicole accept various internships along the East Coast. Hilarity ensues as the girls leave their limos behind and travel by Greyhound bus.

metas.name: Million Dollar Listing New York
metas.description: Follows some of Manhattan's most relentless realtors as they close multimillion dollar deals faster than a yellow cab runs a red light.
